content:
**One Gun Army** is a perk in *Fallout 76*.

Heavy guns deal increased limb damage and have a chance to stagger.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Heavy guns gain a 12% stagger chance and +75% limb damage. | 00320159 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Heavy guns gain a 8% stagger chance and +50% limb damage. | 00320158 | 
| ★ | 1 | Heavy guns gain a 4% stagger chance and +25% limb damage. | 00320157 | 

Before update 59, One Gun Army provided for heavy weapons 4%/8%/12% chance to cripple a limb and 4%/8%/12% increased limb damage.
